summary: Polish-round verification for Dynamo Feed completed on external preview host. All 6 polish items pass on runtime inspection: (1) normal load renders fully with 0 console errors and 0 [content] warnings; audiotest=1 does not crash. (2) Mobile 390x844 shows reel-frame --rail-inset=64px; characters (Marge, Blaze) are positioned left of the action rail (actions at x=330-378, characters center ~x=160-200). (3) Right column: now-watching card is hidden (placeholders filtered), now-reading shows Harry Potter + 'Pretty good' take, now-spanish shows 600 day streak, now-volunteering shows 'looking' status. No 'REPLACE' strings anywhere on page. (4) Comments overlay: no 'Placeholder comments' / 'cast joins in a later update' note; shows real cast comments (Sir Reginald, Marge, Tia). (5) A11Y: feed-frame has role=region aria-label='Reels feed'; keyboard Tab produces 2px solid sage (rgb(147,178,156)) focus outline on action-share; social-linkedin/github/email/resume all have proper aria-label+title. (6) /r/this-does-not-exist loads the feed-frame starting at first reel without crash.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: After loading /r/this-does-not-exist, final URL became /r/the-outreach-part-1 (first reel's slug) rather than '/'. Spec says history.replaceState to '/'. Likely the initial replace to '/' is immediately followed by the scroll-sync URL updater writing the current reel's slug; functionally correct (no crash, lands on first reel), but if strict '/' persistence is required, the scroll-sync should be suppressed on this reset path. Not blocking.
